dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: This is a comfortable environment, a good place to be calm and gather one's thoughts.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: Much like the days in the Jade Chamber...

choices.text: Surely this place doesn't compare to the Jade Chamber...?

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: An environment can't be judged purely on its size or opulence.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I sense the time and effort that you have put into this place, which reminds me of the time and effort I myself spent when constructing the Jade Chamber.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Or, to put it another way, I see this as the "Jade Chamber" that belongs to you.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Please. Kindness has nothing to do with it.
